## Change and exact scope

Describe the problem, statement/hypotheses, affected result IDs and dependencies.

## Proof status and novelty

- [ ] Each new result has exactly one status in the index.
- [ ] Formal, paper, computational, conjectured, negative and exploratory claims are distinguished.
- [ ] Priority is OPEN unless backed by a cited audit.
- [ ] Historical provenance, contributions and any AI/tool assistance are recorded.

## Reproduction

- [ ] Core checks pass, or a justified limitation is stated.
- [ ] Accepted Lean modules compile with the exact toolchain and no sorry/admit/custom axioms.
- [ ] Relevant independent certificate checks and rejection controls are recorded.
- [ ] Expensive checks run/deferred and data coverage are stated.
- [ ] Internal links, manifests and large-asset decisions are updated.
